title: Derived internal Hom adjunction for derived pullback and direct image
statement: Let g:T\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback Lg^* [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image Rg_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category], counit \varepsilon:Lg^*Rg_*\to\mathrm{id} of the adjunction of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general], and derived internal Hom R\mathcal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For K,L\in D(\mathcal O_S) let \gamma_{K,L}:R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(K,L)\to Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*K,Lg^*L) be the adjoint of the canonical map Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\to R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*K,Lg^*L) (the map corresponding under the tensor-internal-Hom adjunction [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] to the composite Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*K\cong Lg^*(R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K)\to Lg^*L of the isomorphism of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product] with Lg^* of evaluation, evaluation R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\to L being the map corresponding to the identity of R\mathcal Hom(K,L) under the same adjunction). Then for M\in D(\mathcal O_S) and E\in D(\mathcal O_T) the composite $$R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(M,Rg_*E)\xrightarrow{\gamma_{M,Rg_*E}}Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,Lg^*Rg_*E)\xrightarrow{Rg_*R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*M,\varepsilon_E)}Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E)$$ is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_S), natural in M and E. Moreover, under the identifications H^0(S,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(M,Rg_*E))=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_S)}(M,Rg_*E) and H^0(S,Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E))=H^0(T,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E))=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_T)}(Lg^*M,E) of [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections, lem-pc-derived-sections-pushforward-comparison], the map it induces on H^0(S,-) is \varphi\mapsto\varepsilon_E\circ Lg^*\varphi.

proof.text: The derived pullback/direct-image adjunction and its counit are supplied by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general]. Evaluation R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\to L is the map corresponding to the identity of R\mathcal Hom(K,L) under the tensor-internal-Hom bijection of [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] (for R\mathcal Hom as in [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]). Composing Lg^* of evaluation with the isomorphism Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*K\cong Lg^*(R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K) of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product] and applying the bijection of [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] on T gives the canonical map Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L) \to R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*K,Lg^*L). Taking its mate under Lg^* \dashv Rg_* defines \gamma_{K,L}; functoriality of these bijections in all variables and naturality of the isomorphism of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product] make this construction natural in K and L.

source.place: Remark 08I3 (cohomology-remark-prepare-fancy-base-change), construction of the internal-Hom comparison

proof.text: For M and E, compose \gamma_{M,Rg_*E} with postcomposition by the counit \varepsilon_E. To prove that this composite is an isomorphism, test it against an arbitrary object A of D(\mathcal O_S). For the source, [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] on S, then [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general], then [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product] give \operatorname{Hom}(A,R\mathcal Hom(M,Rg_*E))\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A\otimes^{\mathbf L}M,Rg_*E)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*(A\otimes^{\mathbf L}M),E)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*A\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*M,E). For the target, [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general] and then [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] on T give \operatorname{Hom}(A,Rg_*R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*M,E))\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*A,R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*M,E))\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*A\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*M,E). All these bijections are natural in A. Under them, postcomposition with the displayed composite is the identity of \operatorname{Hom}(Lg^*A\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*M,E), by the two triangle identities for Lg^* \dashv Rg_*, naturality of the bijections of [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] and of the isomorphism of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-product], and the defining evaluation equation for \gamma. Yoneda therefore gives the asserted isomorphism, and the same calculation is natural in M and E.

source.place: Remark 08I3 and Tag 079W, internal form of the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction

proof.text: Apply H^0(S,-). By [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections], H^0 of the source internal Hom is Hom_{D(\mathcal O_S)}(M,Rg_*E). By [lem-pc-derived-sections-pushforward-comparison], H^0(S,Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E)) identifies with H^0(T,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E)), and the latter is Hom_{D(\mathcal O_T)}(Lg^*M,E) by [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections]. Under these identifications, the mate construction and the second factor are exactly pullback by Lg^* followed by postcomposition with \varepsilon_E, so the induced map is \varphi \mapsto \varepsilon_E \circ Lg^*\varphi.
